PluginData.Author: Taeleus
PluginData.Tooltip: Link your welder, grinder and drill to an owned or faction-shared inventory.
PluginData.Description:
Link your hand tools to an owned or faction-shared inventory. Welders pull components; grinders and drills send materials back.
RANGE Work inside the tethered grid's bounds. Outside: transfers pause. More than 100 m outside: the tether disconnects. Enemy grids overlapping the tethered grid bounds also disconnect it.
COMMANDS /tether - target an inventory port with a tool to connect /tether off - disconnect /tether bounds - toggle wireframe bounds /tether bounds off - hide wireframes
WIREFRAMES Green: working area. Orange: 100 m break-range guide. The actual boundary has rounded corners, so the box extends slightly beyond it at the corners. Bounds hide 30 seconds after disconnection.
